rationale: The NIST AI RMF 1.0 document, specifically the MAP and MANAGE functions, calls for documenting intended context (MAP 1.1), knowledge limits (MAP 2.2), data/TEVV considerations (MAP 2.3), and post-deployment change and recovery processes (MANAGE 2 and MANAGE 4, including processes to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems).
